verdict.rationale: Convex documents an HTTP API that exposes a deployment's public functions at public HTTP endpoints, so a programmatic or AI client can call queries, mutations, and actions and get results. An official CLI and MCP server add further programmatic access. However, the API only surfaces the user's own deployed functions. There is no evidence of a documented public API for driving the product itself (projects, deployments, configuration), and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec. Missing for 10: documented management/platform API beyond calling user-defined functions, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The public functions that define a deployment are exposed at public HTTP endpoints.
These HTTP endpoints allow you to call Convex functions and get the result as a value.
